skill.summary: Convert QQ voice messages in AMR/SILK format to text using pysilk decoding and faster-whisper transcription.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Speech Recognition skill for AMR/SILK:

- Converts QQ/AMR/SILK audio files to text using pysilk and faster-whisper.
- Simple Python API: transcribe_audio("/path/to/audio.amr").
- Supports QQ .amr (SILK_V3), amr, amrnb, amrwb formats.
- Includes setup instructions and model download steps.
